segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I had you at 64 seats today, with the request to add 18 more for the support team on May 1. Is that still the right count?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Close. We need 20, not 18. Two supervisors asked to be included, so total would be 84 seats.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 84 total. On the annual plan, the approved rate is $52 per seat per month, billed annually, so that comes to $52,416 for the year before tax. Same terms as your current agreement, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance will ask if the invoice can be dated May 1 instead of when we sign. Our budget opens then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can set the service start and invoice date to May 1. If we get signature by April 24, implementation can do the admin training on April 29 and have the seats active that Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. We also need the data export feature turned on for just the supervisors. Is that included, or is it a different package?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It’s included in your tier. I’ll list it as supervisor-only access for 6 named users, so it’s clear for kickoff. No added fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Legal had one note last year about auto-renewal. We want 30 days’ notice, not 60.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I checked the current template before the call. Thirty days is available on a 12-month term, so I’ll put that in the order form. Term would run May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy Marcus in finance. If the total matches what you said, I can route it today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have the order form in about 20 minutes, with 84 seats, $52,416 annually, net 30, May 1 invoice date, and the April 29 admin training noted.
